Expression of Interest (EOI):    

  Cardiologists to provide Virtual Cardiac Care for Northern Territory: A Unique Opportunity    

   

 NT Cardiac is a private cardiac specialist practice which has been providing diagnostic and consultative services to both public and private patients over 25 years.  We have a well-established local infrastructure, diagnostic capability and IT infrastructure to enable Virtual cardiac care.  Given the increasing demand, we have successfully piloted remotely supported clinic and diagnostic reporting by cardiologists based in other states of Australia.  Based on this success, we are looking to expand this model of care to support patients from all over the Northern Territory including Aboriginal patients from remote communities. 

   

 NT Cardiac is seeking of Expression of Interest from Cardiologists interested in providing   Virtual Cardiac Care   to both private and public patients across the Northern Territory. This role allows cardiologists to work remotely from their current base locations, leveraging on digital health platforms to deliver high-quality, patient-centred cardiac care across the NT. 

   

 This model of care is ideal for cardiologists who are committed to improving access to specialist services in regional and remote Australia with a keen interest in Aboriginal heart health, and who are comfortable using virtual systems to deliver clinical care. 

   

  About the Role  

 
	 Patient-focused cardiac services, including imaging and diagnostic solutions. 
	 Access to state-of-the-art equipment and facilities. 
	 Supportive team including dedicated admin staff for local support and coordination, nurses, experienced diagnostic technicians, cardiac sonographers. 
	 NT resident cardiologists will provide support and assistance for patients needing urgent face to face consultations or investigations. 
	 Supported with secure access to the following digital platforms:
	 
		  Coviuu or TEAMS  for Telehealth Consultation 
		  Aura Portal  &  VIP.Net-  NT Cardiac’s Patient Management System for scheduling, referrals, and reporting. 
		  HeartLab  – for reviewing and reporting on echocardiograms. 
		  Epiphany  – for access and interpretation of ECGs, Holters, BPM results. 
		  Synapse access to  Radiology images 
	 
	 
	 Flexible or sessional arrangements working arrangements, including after hours. 
	 Competitive remuneration (negotiable) 
 

   

  Key Responsibilities  

 
	 Provide virtual consultation and diagnostic interpretation for referred patients. 
	 Refer, review and report on echocardiograms, ECGs, Holters and other investigations as required. 
	 Liaise with referring clinicians and NT Cardiac team to ensure continuity and quality of care.  
	 Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation via the Aura Portal / Practice Management System. 
 

   

  Requirements  

 
	 Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (FRACP) in Cardiology or equivalent. 
	 Current specialist registration with AHPRA.

result.description:
An exceptional opportunity has become available for a Vocationally Registered (VR) General Practitioner to join a modern, collaborative medical center in Townsville, Queensland. Positioned within a high-demand DPA/MM2 region, this clinic provides a highly supportive and flexible environment that is ideal for doctors under moratorium, those transitioning from hospital to private practice, or practitioners looking to split their time between hospital work and general practice. The incoming doctor will collaborate with a supportive management team within a vibrant, multi-disciplinary environment. Furthermore, this role offers unique long-term potential, including clinical leadership and partnership opportunities for the right candidate looking to shape the future of the clinic. 

 The state-of-the-art medical center features multiple consulting rooms and a fully equipped, modernized treatment room. Operating under a high-earning billing structure, the practice utilizes Best Practice software and handles online bookings seamlessly through HotDoc. Practitioners are backed by an exceptional support framework, including a dedicated administrative team and comprehensive nursing support to optimize Chronic Disease Management (CDM) and daily workflows. With the immense convenience of onsite pathology and co-located allied health services, the facility operates as a comprehensive healthcare hub, offering excellent avenues for doctors looking to expand or utilize their clinical special interests. 

 Doctors at this practice are granted complete clinical autonomy over their practice and absolute control over their schedules. In addition to robust support for continuing professional development (CPD), the practice offers rewarding supervisor and teaching opportunities due to its strong regional network. Recognizing the need for a balanced lifestyle, highly flexible full-time or part-time working arrangements are available for both permanent and locum positions. Financially, the role is incredibly lucrative, offering an attractive 70% of billings, complemented by a $170 per hour minimum income guarantee for the first three months. 

 Located on Queensland's stunning northeastern coast, Townsville offers an enviable tropical lifestyle that perfectly balances professional satisfaction with natural beauty and community spirit. The region is home to top-notch schooling, excellent family-friendly amenities, and a strong hospital network. Residents enjoy year-round tropical weather, affordable living, and endless outdoor activities, with easy access to the Great Barrier Reef and the pristine beaches of nearby Magnetic Island. Whether seeking a long-term career pivot with partnership potential or a rewarding regional locum placement, this position delivers the ultimate blend of clinical freedom, financial prosperity, and a relaxed coastal lifestyle.   Apply Now
